cutoutTemplate: Create an anatomically accurate side-profile {species} on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be uniform with no shadow, gradient, texture, reflection, floor, or lighting variation. Keep the full shark separated from the border with crisp edges and generous padding. Do not use green on the shark. No text or watermark.

iconStyle: Warm hand-painted storybook illustration for ages 5-7, soft gouache texture, rounded friendly shapes, gentle pastel palette, one simple clear subject that reads instantly when shown small, bold readable silhouette, no text, no watermark, no borders.
iconStyleReference: Match apps/cat-math/Resources/Art/cat-mittens.png and cat-sprout.png. Generate each as a new image, not an edit.
tileComposition: Square image. One subject centred, filling about 70 percent of the frame with an even margin, on a plain soft warm cream background (#FBF3E4) with no other scenery. When the subject is a place or a scene (an ocean, a reef, a desert, a farm), paint it as a small rounded vignette centred on the same plain cream background.
cutoutComposition: Square image. One single object centred, filling about 75 percent of the frame, with crisp clean edges and generous padding, on a perfectly flat solid pure green (#00FF00) chroma-key background: uniform, no shadow, no gradient, no texture, no floor. Do not use any bright green on the object itself; if the object must be green, use a dark green or yellow-green clearly different from #00FF00. After generating, key out the green to transparency, crop to the object and resize to 256 px.
